title: Beebo Entertainment: testing status by feature
howToRead: percentComplete = checks passed out of 5 checks, 20 percent each: Built, Automated tests, Real device, Real-world check, Ready to call Available. It measures how much of our test list has passed, not how finished or bug-free a feature is. 100 means all five checks passed.

features.name: Opening the app and the five tabs
features.leftToReach100: TalkBack (screen reader) check.
features.changeNote: Android tester16 (build 66): a Samsung S9+ installed it over tester15, kept its sign-in and opened on Home in under a second. The Home, Browse, Library and More tabs loaded and no crash was logged. The Play tab was not opened in this check. Not tried on other phones.

features.name: Playing films, seeking, picture-in-picture
features.leftToReach100: Screen-off playback; the 480p switch error re-checked on a phone; seeking and floating player re-run on the newest build.
features.changeNote: Android tester16 (build 66) on a Samsung S9+ at home on Wi-Fi: a film resumed from the Resume prompt and played with picture, pause held its place, play carried on, and fast-forward jumped about 15 seconds. Picture-in-picture, subtitles, quality changes and casting were not tried in this check.

features.name: Away from home (direct, then relay)
features.leftToReach100: Oct 3 (correction): sign-in and Continue watching worked through the updated server, but the phone was on the same network as the home PC, so this was not an away-from-home video test. Earlier the same day the owner reported a direct connection on mobile data (5G). Left: a recorded mobile-data playback test and a Beebo Relay test on the newest build; relay price decision.
